verdict.rationale: Termius docs mention AI-assisted command generation from natural language (termius-docs-6), which is a narrow AI helper feature rather than a full agentic assistant capable of being delegated multi-step tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous task execution, multi-step delegation, or a persistent AI assistant beyond single-command translation, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this AI feature's real-world use.
